verdict.rationale: Brex documents a yield-earning business account (up to 3.70%), which covers the high-yield element of the story. Nothing in the pack shows a dedicated savings sub-account or rules that automatically move cash into a cushion. The Payments API covers vendor ACH, wires and checks, not internal treasury sweeps, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented savings or treasury sub-accounts, automated transfer or sweep rules, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
